label: Current density sets the width
subgoals: Sweep a unit-width device and record density, gain and capacitance
Reindex the sweep by gm over Id
Divide the required current by the current density to get the width

label: Interpolating between rows
subgoals: Locate the two table rows around the design point
Interpolate the density linearly by the fractional position
Prefer interpolation in log density where density is exponential

label: A complete sizing step
subgoals: Choose gm over Id and channel length from gain and speed needs
Divide gm by gm over Id, then divide the current by the density
Read intrinsic gain and capacitance from the same table row
